arxiv-1710-02229.title: On winning strategies for Banach-Mazur games
arxiv-1710-02229.creator: Anumat Srivastava
arxiv-1710-02229.description: Abstract We give topological and game theoretic definitions and theorems necessary for defining a Banach-Mazur game, and apply these definitions to formalize the game. We then state and prove two theorems which give necessary conditions for existence of winning strategies for players in a Banach-Mazur game. 1 Introduction In this section we formulate and prove our main theorems.

arxiv-2105-10335.title: Data-driven Weight Initialization with Sylvester Solvers Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2105-10335.creator: Debasmit Das, Yash Bhalgat & Fatih Porikli
arxiv-2105-10335.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a data-driven scheme to initialize the parameters of a deep neural network. This is in contrast to traditional approaches which randomly initialize parameters by sampling from transformed standard distributions. Such methods do not use the training data to produce a more informed initialization.

arxiv-2106-07246.title: Note on a question of Wilf
arxiv-2106-07246.creator: M. Hellus, A. Rechenauer, R. Waldi
arxiv-2106-07246.description: Abstract Let S S be a numerical semigroup with Frobenius number f f , genus g g and embedding dimension e e . In 1978 Wilf asked the question, whether f + 1 − g f + 1 ≥ 1 e \frac{f+1-g}{f+1}\geq\frac{1}{e} .

arxiv-2107-00710.title: Long-Short Ensemble Network for Bipolar Manic-Euthymic State Recognition Based on Wrist-worn Sensors
arxiv-2107-00710.creator: Ulysse Côté-Allard 1, Petter Jakobsen 2,3, Andrea Stautland 3, Tine Nordgreen 4,5, Ole Bernt Fasmer 2 , 3 , {}^{2,3}, Ketil Joachim Oedegaard 2,3, Jim Torresen 1
arxiv-2107-00710.description: Abstract Manic episodes of bipolar disorder can lead to uncritical behaviour and delusional psychosis, often with destructive consequences for those affected and their surroundings. Early detection and intervention of a manic episode are crucial to prevent escalation, hospital admission and premature death.

arxiv-2206-11109.title: Localisation of Dirac modes in gauge theories and Goldstone’s theorem at finite temperature
arxiv-2206-11109.creator: Matteo Giordano
arxiv-2206-11109.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matteo Giordano. I discuss the possible effects of a finite density of localised near-zero Dirac modes in the chiral limit of gauge theories with N f N_{f} degenerate fermions. I focus in particular on the fate of the massless quasi-particle excitations predicted by the finite-temperature version of Goldstone’s theorem, for which I provide an alternative and generalised proof based on a Euclidean SU ​ ( N f ) A {\rm SU}(N_{f})_{A} Ward-Takahashi identity.

arxiv-2407-01604.title: Disentangling the X-ray variability in the Lyman continuum emitter Haro 11
arxiv-2407-01604.creator: A. Danehkar, S. Silich, E. C. Herenz, G. Östlin
arxiv-2407-01604.description: Abstract Context. Lyman break analogs in the local Universe serve as counterparts to Lyman break galaxies (LBGs) at high redshifts, which are widely regarded as major contributors to cosmic reionization in the early stages of the Universe. Aims. We studied XMM-Newton and Chandra observations of the nearby LBG analog Haro 11, which contains two X-ray-bright sources, X1 and X2.

arxiv-2408-04569.title: Activation degree thresholds and expressiveness of polynomial neural networks
arxiv-2408-04569.creator: Bella Finkel, Jose Israel Rodriguez, Chenxi Wu, Thomas Yahl
arxiv-2408-04569.description: Abstract We study the expressive power of deep polynomial neural networks through the geometry of their neurovariety. We introduce the notion of the activation degree threshold of a network architecture to express when the dimension of the neurovariety achieves its theoretical maximum.

arxiv-2410-23330.title: CLIPErase: Efficient Unlearning of Visual-Textual Associations in CLIP
arxiv-2410-23330.creator: Tianyu Yang, Lisen Dai, Xiangqi Wang, Minhao Cheng, Yapeng Tian, Xiangliang Zhang
arxiv-2410-23330.description: Abstract Machine unlearning (MU) has gained significant attention as a means to remove the influence of specific data from a trained model without requiring full retraining. While progress has been made in unimodal domains like text and image classification, unlearning in multimodal models remains relatively under-explored.

arxiv-2411-05191.title: Well-Posedness and Long-Time Dynamics of a Water-Waves Model with Time-Varying Boundary Delay Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author: roberto.capistranofilho@ufpe.br
arxiv-2411-05191.creator: G. J. Bautista, R. de A. Capistrano–Filho ∗, B. Chentouf, O. Sierra Fonseca
arxiv-2411-05191.description: Abstract . A higher-order nonlinear Boussinesq system with a time-dependent boundary delay is considered. Sufficient conditions are presented to ensure the well-posedness of the problem by utilizing Kato’s variable norm technique and the Fixed-Point Theorem. More significantly, the energy decay for the linearized problem is demonstrated using the energy method. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 35Q53, 93D15, 93C20; Secondary: 93D30.

arxiv-2507-12955.title: Data Movement Model for the Vera C. Rubin Observatory
arxiv-2507-12955.creator: \firstname Fabio \lastname Hernandez, \firstname Mark G. \lastname Beckett, \firstname Andrew \lastname Hanushevsky, \firstname Tim \lastname Jenness, \firstname Kian-Tat \lastname Lim, \firstname Peter \lastname Love, \firstname Timothy \lastname Noble, \firstname Stephen \lastname Pietrowicz, \fir
arxiv-2507-12955.description: Abstract The sky images captured nightly by the camera on the Vera C. Rubin Observatory’s telescope will be processed across facilities on three continents. Data acquisition will occur at the observatory’s location on Cerro Pachón in the Andes mountains of Chile.

arxiv-2509-09984.title: Unified g g -mode and r r -mode Analysis of Accreting White Dwarf Stars Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2509-09984.creator: Praphull Kumar, Dean M. Townsley
arxiv-2509-09984.description: Abstract Dwarf novae are a subset of cataclysmic variables that accrete material intermittently in short-duration outbursts with sometimes long quiescent intervals in between. During the quiescent state, the white dwarf (WD) photosphere may be observable. Some of these systems show periodic variability consistent with a non-radial oscillation.

arxiv-2602-18726.title: WiCompass : Oracle-driven Data Scaling for mmWave Human Pose Estimation CCS: Human-centered computing Ubiquitous and mobile computing systems and tools Conference: The 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking; October 26–30, 2026; Austin, TX, USA The 32nd Annual Intern
arxiv-2602-18726.creator: Bo Liang ℙ {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{P}$}} , Chen Gong ℙ {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{P}$}} , Haobo Wang ℙ {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{P}$}} , Qirui Liu ℙ {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{P}$}} , Rungui Zhou ℙ {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{P}$}} , Fengzhi Shao 𝕌 {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{U}$}} , Yubo Wang 𝕌 {}^{\textrm{$\mathbb{U}$}} , Wei Gao
arxiv-2602-18726.description: Abstract . Millimeter-wave Human Pose Estimation (mmWave HPE) promises privacy but suffers from poor generalization under distribution shifts. We demonstrate that brute-force data scaling is ineffective for out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness; efficiency and coverage are the true bottlenecks. To address this, we introduce WiCompass , a coverage-aware data-collection framework.

arxiv-2602-24260.title: Observer-Based Estimation and Hydrostatic Inertia Modeling for Cooperative Transport of Variable-Inertia Loads with Quadrotors
arxiv-2602-24260.creator: Jacob R. Goodman, Leonardo J. Colombo, Juan I. Giribet
arxiv-2602-24260.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jacob R. Goodman, Leonardo J. Colombo, Juan I. Giribet. We address load-parameter estimation in cooperative aerial transport with time-varying mass and inertia, as in fluid-carrying payloads. Using an intrinsic manifold model of the multi–quadrotor–load dynamics, we combine a geometric tracking controller with an observer for parameter identification. We estimate mass from measurable kinematics and commanded forces, and handle variable inertia via an inertia surrogate that reproduces the load’s rotational dynamics for control and state propagation.

pmc-11507012.title: Heyde Syndrome Unveiled: A Case Report with Current Literature Review and Molecular Insights
pmc-11507012.creator: Mladen Maksić, Irfan Corović, Isidora Stanisavljević, Dušan Radojević, Tijana Veljković, Željko Todorović, Marina Jovanović, Nataša Zdravković, Bojan Stojanović, Bojana Simović Marković, Ivan Jovanović, Isabella Russo
pmc-11507012.description: Heyde syndrome, marked by aortic stenosis, gastrointestinal bleeding from angiodysplasia, and acquired von Willebrand syndrome, is often underreported. Shear stress from a narrowed aortic valve degrades von Willebrand factor multimers, leading to angiodysplasia formation and von Willebrand factor deficiency. This case report aims to raise clinician awareness of Heyde syndrome, its complexity, and the need for a multidisciplinary approach.

pmc-11532485.title: Spatiotemporal hierarchies of face representation in the human ventral temporal cortex
pmc-11532485.creator: Sina Salehi, Mohammad Reza A. Dehaqani, Jessica Schrouff, Clara Sava-Segal, Omri Raccah, Sori Baek
pmc-11532485.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, we examined the relatively unexplored realm of face perception, investigating the activities within human brain face-selective regions during the observation of faces at both subordinate and superordinate levels. We recorded intracranial EEG signals from the ventral temporal cortex in neurosurgical patients implanted with subdural electrodes during viewing of face subcategories (human, mammal, bird, and marine faces) as well as various non-face control stimuli.

pmc-11712108.title: Associations between cognitive function and long‐term cognitive enhancement therapy: Insights from a 5‐year follow‐up, case study
pmc-11712108.creator: Stalo Zarouna, Antonia Tziannarou, Savvina Chrysostomou, Sotiria Moza
pmc-11712108.description: BackgroundA 69‐year‐old retired businessman, born in 1954, with 12 years of education, had been participating in cognitive enhancement sessions for the past 5 years. His medical history included two ischemic strokes, left hemiplegia, as well as disturbances in the left visual field.

pmc-12373740.title: Molecular characterization and prognostic implications of KRAS mutations in pancreatic cancer patients: insights from multi-cohort analysis
pmc-12373740.creator: Yubo Jiang, Gang Mai, Xiaokai Zhao, Meng Tang, Pengmin Yang, Qian Cheng, He Tian, Zuoxing Niu, Xintao Wang, Jiao Wang, Yudong Zhu, Jieyi Li, Ziying Gong, Daoyun Zhang, Huirong Xu
pmc-12373740.description: KRAS mutations drive pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) progression. This study investigates molecular heterogeneity among KRAS subtypes and their prognostic implications. This study explores KRAS mutations in PDAC, analyzing molecular heterogeneity and prognosis across our hospital cohort (SDFM, n = 113) with TCGA cohort (n = 183) and QCMG cohort (n = 383).

pmc-12616229.title: Silent circulation of Bluetongue and Schmallenberg viruses in Culicoides biting midges in northwestern Italy: implications for the 2024 BTV outbreak
pmc-12616229.creator: Angela Maria Catania, Elena Grego, Laura Tomassone, Cagnotti Giulia, Di Muro Giorgia, Ferrini Sara, Antonio D’Angelo
pmc-12616229.description: Vector-borne viruses like Bluetongue (BTV) and Schmallenberg virus (SBV) pose an ongoing threat to livestock health across Europe. Transmitted by Culicoides biting midges, these pathogens can circulate silently, escaping early detection. In this study, we investigated the presence and infection status of Culicoides on 2 cattle farms in northwestern Italy, where congenital malformations and abortions had previously been reported.

pmc-12984973.title: Application of Quercus pubescens Acorn Flour and Xanthan Gum in Gluten-Free Cookies: RSM Optimization and Quality Evaluation
pmc-12984973.creator: Jasmina Lukinac, Dragana Medaković, Daliborka Koceva Komlenić, Ana Šušak, Marko Jukić
pmc-12984973.description: Despite the growing demand for functional gluten-free (GF) foods, the application of Quercus pubescens acorn flour remains largely underexplored. This study addresses this gap by optimizing GF cookies using response surface methodology (RSM) and prepared with Q. pubescens acorn flour and xanthan gum to balance technological quality, sensory acceptability, and functional value.

pmc-13051043.title: The habitual, spatial and temporal conditions of everyday youth intergroup contact in an ethnically diverse city
pmc-13051043.creator: Sumedh Rao, Pier‐Luc Dupont, David Manley, Laura K Taylor, Shelley McKeown
pmc-13051043.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). There is substantial evidence that positive intergroup contact can reduce prejudice. Most everyday interactions, however, are not deliberately structured to be positive, and individuals do not always engage in intergroup contact even when there is opportunity. The present research adopts a qualitative approach to understand how youth negotiate everyday contact with outgroup friends and acquaintances in the ethnically diverse city of Bradford, England.

pmc-13195844.title: Smart hydrogels for overcoming cancer multidrug resistance
pmc-13195844.creator: Yong Wang, Baoyan Liu, Zou-Fang Huang, Harsh Patel, Jinming Yu, Man Hu, Zhe-Sheng Chen
pmc-13195844.description: Multidrug resistance (MDR) remains the principal impediment to curative oncology, driven by complex interplays between cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment (TME). While nanomedicines have sought to overcome these delivery barriers, their clinical translation is often hampered by the heterogeneity of the enhanced permeability and retention (EPR) effect and by inefficient intratumoral delivery.

pmc-13246971.title: Personalised Dosimetry in Nuclear Medicine: Bridging Physics, Biology and AI for Next Generation Radiopharmaceutical Therapy
pmc-13246971.creator: Joycie Shanmugiah, Jin Su Kim
pmc-13246971.description: Radiopharmaceutical dosimetry is rapidly evolving from a physics-dominated calculation tool to a central pillar of precision nuclear medicine. As targeted radionuclide therapies expand across indications, there is a growing clinical imperative to personalize dose estimation, predict therapeutic efficacy and mitigate organ toxicity.

pmc-13309887.title: Comparison of efficacy of procalcitonin (PCT) and serum C-reactive protein (CRP) as biochemical markers of sepsis in pediatric intensive care unit (ICU)
pmc-13309887.creator: Ali Abdur Rahman, Asfand Tariq, Lubna Riaz
pmc-13309887.description: Background & Objectives:Sepsis in pediatric population has a high mortality rate and global health impact. Explicit diagnostic testing is critical in order to ensure timely and accurate diagnosis. Our study is aimed at comparing the efficacy of CRP and PCT, keeping blood culture as gold standard, in diagnosing sepsis in pediatric population to improve treatment and survival.

pmc-13347539.title: Apathy linked to higher amyloid burden and cognitive deterioration in Parkinson's disease
pmc-13347539.creator: Carmen Gasca-Salas, Roberto Fernández-Fernández, Rafael Rodríguez-Rojas, Beatriz Fernández-Rodríguez, Lina García-Cañamaque, Guillermo Lahera, Clara Trompeta
pmc-13347539.description: BackgroundApathy, defined as a quantitative reduction in goal-directed activity, is a non-motor manifestation that can be present in Parkinson's disease (PD). It seems to be a risk factor for conversion to dementia (PDD) in this population. Amyloid-β deposition also predicts progression to PDD.

uslaw-usc-t43-s325.title: 43 U.S.C. § 325 — Resident citizenship of State as qualification for entry
uslaw-usc-t43-s325.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s325.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 9 (Desert-Land Entries). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Excepting in the State of Nevada, no person shall be entitled to make entry of desert lands unless he be a resident citizen of the State or Territory in which the land sought to be entered is located.
